name: OT cybersecurity
principle: Operational technology (DCS, SCADA, PLC) has been shown vulnerable to attack; defence in depth, patching, segmentation and secure remote access are the main measures.

process_steps.name: Inventory and map OT assets and networks
Segment networks and control remote access

performance.basis: the worm used four zero-day attacks per Wikipedia SCADA page

limitations: The ICS page does not mention IEC 62443 or specific oil and gas incidents

sources.note: Wikipedia, Industrial control system, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

gaps.item: IEC 62443 requirements and oil and gas incidents
gaps.action: Add the standard and incident references.

gaps.reason: The sources read name no suppliers for this technology.
gaps.action: Add suppliers from vendor pages, with the product each supplies.

gaps.item: capital cost and operating or unit cost, with dollar year and basis
gaps.reason: No open source read so far gives costs for this technology.
